For upper chest, Incline Barbell Press and Incline Dumbbell Press are your best bets—the incline targets that area hard. Since you're chasing 100kg on flat bench in 3 months, the flat Barbell Bench Press is still king, but mixing in incline work builds the upper chest and helps your main lift 💪
